coverage.description: Flatten source occurrences for expression leaf keys. Reject fewer than two occurrences or nonzero constant before duplicate tests. With all_used false, reject any repeated occurrence globally. With true, check repetitions separately inside compound and simple leaf partitions. Then require q_leaf0..nums and, when all_used, all0..nums.
